scope: Development validation: first two official validation windows at each length. Overlap across lengths and earlier development use; not a fresh holdout.
rule: Among the four revisions, require lower CE than sparse at every measured context; then minimize the unweighted mean of the three context CEs. Rule recorded after inspecting validation, before version-2 test execution.
deployment_numerics: Validation used a log-mass-shift implementation of the cap. Deployment uses the algebraically equivalent direct bounded mixture, fixing extreme-logit cancellation and empty-tail gradients. Uncapped arithmetic unchanged. This is not a claim of bitwise validation/deployment equivalence; deployment sources are hashed in the notebook manifest.
test_fence: The official test corpus and nine fixed probes were already inspected in version 1. Version 2 is a frozen regression comparison, not a pristine holdout. No gains are refitted and no configuration is selected using version-2 results.
